topic: 數字、時間、日期 (asking time, days)
can_do_en: I can ask and tell the time, say the day and the date, and agree on when and where to meet.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄚ ㄈㄤ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄧㄢˇ
dialogue.en: Afang, what time is it now?

dialogue.speaker: 阿芳
dialogue.zh: 十點四十分。你要去哪裡？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄕˊ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄙˋ ㄕˊ ㄈㄣ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zh: 我要去上課，我十一點有中文課。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄕˊ ㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄨㄣˊ ㄎㄜˋ
dialogue.en: I'm going to class. I have Chinese class at eleven.

dialogue.speaker: 阿芳
dialogue.zh: 今天禮拜四，你也有課喔？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄞˋ ㄙˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧㄝˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄎㄜˋ ㄛ
dialogue.en: Today's Thursday. You have class on Thursdays too?

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zh: 對啊，我星期一到星期四都有課，十一點到十二點半。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄉㄨㄟˋ ˙ㄚ ㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄧㄥ ㄑㄧˊ ㄧ ㄉㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄥ ㄑㄧˊ ㄙˋ ㄉㄡ ㄧㄡˇ ㄎㄜˋ ㄕˊ ㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄕˊ ㄦˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄅㄢˋ

dialogue.speaker: 阿芳
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄚˋ ㄋㄧˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄞˋ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄎㄨㄥˋ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.en: Then are you free on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: 阿芳
dialogue.zh: 禮拜六是我生日啦！我們一起去吃飯，好不好？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄞˋ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄕˋ ㄨㄛˇ ㄕㄥ ㄖˋ ˙ㄌㄚ ㄨㄛˇ ˙ㄇㄣ ㄧ ㄑㄧˇ ㄑㄩˋ ㄔ ㄈㄢˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄠˇ
dialogue.en: Saturday's my birthday! Let's go out to eat together, OK?

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ˙ㄚ ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄞˋ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄕˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄏㄠˋ
dialogue.en: Sure! What's the date on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: 阿芳
dialogue.zh: 今天十二號，禮拜六是十四號。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄕˊ ㄦˋ ㄏㄠˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄞˋ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄕˋ ㄕˊ ㄙˋ ㄏㄠˋ
dialogue.en: Today's the 12th, so Saturday is the 14th.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄢˋ
dialogue.en: What time? Where shall we meet?

dialogue.speaker: 阿芳
dialogue.zh: 晚上六點半，在屏東火車站。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄢˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄅㄢˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄨㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄓㄢˋ
dialogue.en: Six thirty in the evening, at Pingtung train station.

dialogue.speaker: 安娜
dialogue.zh: 好，禮拜六晚上六點半，火車站見！
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄞˋ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄨㄢˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄌㄧㄡˋ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄅㄢˋ ㄏㄨㄛˇ ㄔㄜ ㄓㄢˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ
dialogue.en: OK, Saturday at six thirty in the evening, see you at the station!

dialogue.speaker: 阿芳
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄋㄧˇ ㄎㄨㄞˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄎㄜˋ ˙ㄅㄚ ㄗㄞˋ ㄐㄧㄢˋ
dialogue.en: OK, hurry off to class. Bye!

grammar.note_en: Time phrases go from big to small and sit before the verb: 我十一點有中文課, 禮拜六晚上六點半，火車站見. In speech the date is 號 (十四號), and 半 means half past (十二點半).
Clock times and dates are built place by place, so the order changes the number: 十四 'ten four' is 14 (十四號) but 四十 'four ten' is 40 (十點四十分). 十一 and 十二 work the same way.

pronunciation.note_en: Keep 十 ㄕˊ and 四 ㄙˋ apart: for ㄕ the tongue tip is up just behind the gum ridge, ㄙ is a plain s, and neither has an 'ee' sound (the empty rhyme). The tones differ too, so 十四 ㄕˊ ㄙˋ (14) and 四十 ㄙˋ ㄕˊ (40) sound clearly different. 星 ㄒㄧㄥ in 星期 is the third sound: tongue tip down, lips spread. 幾點 is a 3+3 pair, so 幾 is said rising (like ㄐㄧˊ ㄉㄧㄢˇ) though it is written ㄐㄧˇ.

speaking.prompt_en: Invite a friend to eat out this weekend. Ask what time it is, say which days you have class or work, then agree on the day, the date, the time and the place to meet.
speaking.prompt_zh: 你想跟朋友一起去吃飯。請說：禮拜幾、幾號、幾點、在哪裡見。
checklist_en: asked with 幾點 or 幾號
put the time before the verb (晚上六點半…見)
named a day with 星期 or 禮拜 (禮拜六)
kept 十 ㄕˊ and 四 ㄙˋ apart in 十四 and 四十

writing.prompt_en: Write 3 or 4 sentences about your week: which days you have class or work and from what time to what time, and one plan with a day, a date, a time and a place.
writing.prompt_zh: 請寫三、四句：你星期幾有課或上班？幾點到幾點？這個禮拜六你要做什麼？
writing.model_zh: 我星期一到星期四都有中文課，上午十一點上課，中午十二點半下課。這個禮拜六是十四號，是我朋友的生日。我們晚上六點半在屏東火車站見，一起去吃飯。

culture_en: 星期 and 禮拜 both name the days of the week (星期六 = 禮拜六 = Saturday). In everyday Taiwan speech you will hear 禮拜 a lot, while written schedules and opening hours often use 星期 or the short form 週 (週六). People tell the time on a 12-hour clock with 早上, 下午 or 晚上 in front (晚上六點半), but train timetables, like the ones at Pingtung station, use the 24-hour clock: 晚上六點半 is 18:30.
